headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber security model
dek: The model finds flaws and strays less, per The Verge.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: GPT-6 Cyber
body: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a security model the company says is better at finding vulnerabilities, per The Verge.
It reaches the top tier of Daybreak Red first, a program for security researchers.

points.t: Found 81 unknown flaws in the browser, says OpenAI.
Scanned the kernel and flagged 948 potential issues (TechCrunch).
Went off limits in under 1% of tests (The Verge).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: "Critical" risk
body: OpenAI raised the model to "Critical" on its Preparedness Framework, per The Verge.
The earlier version was "High." The chance of acting off limits fell from about 5% to under 1% (The Verge).

stat.cap: chance of going off limits, says The Verge

items.t: The rest of the tier gets it in coming weeks (The Verge).

caption.hook: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a security model it says goes off limits far less often.
body: Per The Verge, the model is better at finding vulnerabilities and reaches the top tier of Daybreak Red first, a program for security researchers. OpenAI raised its rating to Critical on the Preparedness Framework, up from High for GPT-5.6 Cyber.

The chance of acting off limits in tests fell from about 5% to under 1%, says The Verge. OpenAI says the model found 81 unknown flaws in Firefox, and TechCrunch reports it flagged 948 potential issues in the Linux kernel. The company also announced $1 billion for security professionals working in Daybreak.
caption.cta: Save it for later and send it to someone following AI.
